name: Mumblecore
summary: A no-budget film about young people who talk, fail to say what they mean and drift. It uses a small digital camera, friends as actors, real rooms and half-improvised speech. The picture is plain and the mood is awkward.

philosophy.core_thesis: A cheap digital camera and a few friends are enough to film the small, awkward moments of a relationship, so the film trusts the talk and not the polish.
design_principles: Shoot with a small digital camera and a crew of 2 to 5 people, with a budget under 100,000 USD.
Cast friends and non-professional actors, and write an outline with 50% or more of the lines improvised.
Film in real flats, cars and cafés with the available light, and add no lamp.
Frame in 16:9 or 4:3 with a 28mm to 50mm lens, and keep the camera at eye level.
Hold a take for 30 to 120 s, and let the pauses and the stammer stay in the cut.
Zoom or re-frame in the take, and let the camera hunt for the person who speaks.
Use a few quiet songs by friends and no score, and keep the sound of the room.
anti_patterns: A famous actor in a styled role
A score that tells the viewer how to feel
A tidy, written line without a pause
A smooth dolly or a crane shot

composition.framing: A plain 16:9 frame at eye level, with a loose, shifting medium shot; the second person often sits half out of the frame.
composition.staging_in_depth: 2 planes: a speaker in the foreground and a room or a street behind, as found.
composition.subject_placement: Wherever the person sits; the frame corrects 0.3 to 1 s late.

principles.rule: Keep a loose frame that lets one person sit half out of the shot.
principles.value: head or shoulder cuts 5% to 20% at 1 edge

principles.rule: Follow the speaker with a small zoom, and let the frame lag.
Use the room as it is: 2 planes, one person and a wall or window.
Use only the light in the room.
principles.value: 0 added lamps, 2:1 or lower key to fill

principles.rule: Hold the take through the pause and the stammer.
principles.value: 8 to 15 s average shot, takes of 30 to 120 s

camera_and_movement.movement: A handheld follow, a small zoom to find the speaker, and a long static two-shot.
camera_and_movement.support: Handheld small digital camera; a tabletop or a car seat
camera_and_movement.camera_height: 1.2 to 1.7 m, eye level or seated level
camera_and_movement.move_speed: Walking pace 1.0 to 1.5 m/s; a zoom over 1 to 3 s

lens_and_format.focal_length: a zoom lens of 28mm to 70mm equivalent
lens_and_format.focus: Autofocus, and a slow drift between two faces
equipment: a small DV or HD camcorder

light.quality: Whatever the room has: a window, a ceiling lamp and a screen glow; a flat look with a clipped window.
light.direction: From a window or a lamp in the frame.
light.colour_temperature: Mixed, left as found: 3200K lamps and 5600K windows
light.source: Windows, ceiling lamps and the screens of a laptop or a phone

colour_and_grade.treatment: A plain colour image straight from the camera, with a little lift in the shadows and no stylised grade.
grade_recipe: Set the white balance to the room and do not match mixed lamps.
Lift the blacks to 5% and keep the contrast at 0 to +5%.
Leave the video noise in the shadows.
Do not add a LUT, grain or a vignette.
colour_and_grade.texture: Standard-definition video noise and a flat, clipped window

editing_and_rhythm.average_shot_length: 8 to 20 s (estimate; check Cinemetrics for each title)
editing_and_rhythm.shot_length_range: 3 s for a glance to 3 min for one talk
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Cut at the end of a line or a pause; keep the awkward silence and the jump from a repeated take.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut, a short black for a time jump; no dissolve.

sound.approach: On-camera or boom sound of the room, with traffic, a fridge and clothes noise.
sound.dialogue: Half-improvised, overlapping and halting; people trail off and start again.
sound.music: A few quiet songs by friends or small bands, in the scene or over the credits; no score.
sound.loudness: −20 LUFS integrated, with a wide range

titles_and_graphics.treatment: A plain white title on black or over the first shot; a simple end card.
titles_and_graphics.type: A plain sans-serif or a handwritten face in white, 2 to 4 s per card.

shot_primer.opening: Open in the middle of a small talk and keep the first cut for 15 to 30 s.

shot_list.shot: A pause and a look away
A text message on a phone

positive: two friends talk on a couch

emotion.target_response: Awkward closeness: the viewer sits in a room with people who cannot say what they feel and recognises it.

use_cases: brand films with a real, friendly voice
avoid_when: The brief needs a glossy, high-end look.
The story needs a plot of action or spectacle.

modifiers.how: Keep the handheld and the real rooms; add a strict set of rules, such as no added light and no score.
Keep the talk; move the camera to a locked, centred frame and set the colour in a pastel palette.
